Hi Laura — great to hear. Quick answers and a proposed approach below; attaching a draft MAP and a PO template.

Summary (short):
- MAP / Milestones: 3-week evaluation: Week 1 (ingest & baseline), Week 2 (integration + perf tuning), Week 3 (acceptance & QA). Acceptance criteria and success metrics are in the attached MAP.
- Billing trigger: Billing begins when the Customer Acceptance milestone is signed OR on the effective date of a mutually executed PO, whichever comes first.
- Pricing & ramp: We offer a 25% pilot discount for the 3-week evaluation if you commit to a 3-month ramp (monthly min usage commitments). After ramp, standard list pricing applies unless a committed volume discount is applied as outlined in the MAP.
- Payment terms: Standard terms are Net30. For procurement preference we can accept Net45 or Net60 on the first 12-month committed contract with an adjusted discount schedule (we’d need an exec approval for Net60).
- Invoice cadence & PO: Monthly invoicing is standard. We require either (A) a signed PO that references the contract/SOW before the first invoice, or (B) a signed contract with a confirmed billing start date; if option B, PO can be received within 30 days of first invoice.

Next steps proposed:
1) We finalize the MAP (attached) and the acceptance criteria — target to have both signed by Dec 3.
2) Procurement submits PO draft by Dec 6 or confirms they will follow within 30 days of first invoice.
3) Pilot kickoff Dec 7; billing start after Customer Acceptance or PO effective date.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB)], [Attachment: GreenArc_PO_Template.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

Hi Laura — Marissa on the SE side. Quick notes on acceptance & milestone ties to billing so everyone has the same expectation:

- Acceptance criteria are behavioral + performance-based: 99th percentile latency target, pass rate for hallucination tests on the evaluation prompt set, and integration smoke tests (detailed in the MAP).
- Customer Acceptance is documented via an Acceptance Checklist signed by a named PO from GreenArc (name + title) and emailed to contracts@redwood.com.
- Operationally, invoices are generated on the 1st of the month for the prior calendar month usage. If Customer Acceptance occurs mid-month, the first invoice will pro-rate usage from the billing start date.

Regarding the 25% pilot discount and clawback: if the pilot discount is taken and the contract is not converted to the agreed ramp within 45 days of the pilot end, Redwood reserves the right to invoice the difference between pilot and standard pricing back to the effective date of billable usage. We can limit the clawback cap to 50% of the pilot discount if that helps — happy to put language in the SOW.

Net60 approvals: finance needs a signed commitment (deal_id + contract) plus an internal legal sign-off; typical turnaround is 5–7 business days after submission for standard-sized deals, longer for larger enterprise exceptions.

Suggested operational flow:
- Procurement provides PO before pilot start OR confirms PO will arrive within 30 days of first invoice.
- Contract signature triggers the SOW and the DocuSign envelope we can send (we’ll include the capped clawback language if GreenArc wants).

Would you like us to prepare a version of the MAP with the 50% clawback cap and a Net60 addendum for exec approval?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole\Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
